thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Region us-west-1 experiencing elevated 5xx and auth egress latency affecting Hosted API + Dedicated pools. Start: 2024-03-25T18:33:19Z. Symptoms: STS/KMS timeouts, upstream 503s. Pager: maria_oncall.
maria_oncall: ack. on it, paging SRE + support.
kevin_sre: i'm jumping in. can you paste quick metrics (5xx %, p95)?
maria_oncall: hosted-api/us-west-1 5xx 12.1% (4200 rps), p95 1.2s. auth/KMS p95 860ms. dedicated-gw 5xx 7.0%. majority 503/504 from STS.
samir_platform: seeing nat conn resets to sts.amazonaws.com, tls handshake timeouts. probable egress/control-plane issue in us-west-1.
lisa_support: customers reporting timeouts for us-west-1 — small cluster of accounts. triaging DMs.
kevin_sre: mitigation plan: 1) route non-data-local traffic out of us-west-1 -> us-east-2/eu-west-1 2) increase auth token cache TTL + enable fallback 3) reduce batching window to lower tail latency 4) bump auth retry/backoff.
maria_oncall: applying 2 + 3 now.
kevin_sre: issuing routing override via control-plane (rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100%).
```
# curl example
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/routing/override \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
 -d '{"from_region":"us-west-1","to_regions":["us-east-2","eu-west-1"],"priority":"egress-degraded"}'
```
kevin_sre: started 10% rollout at 18:39Z.
incident-bot: [UPDATE] routing override 10% deployed. initial cohort error-rate down.
kevin_sre: routed cohort (us-east-2) 5xx -> 3.1%. global us-west-1 still ~8.5%.
maria_oncall: token cache updated: token_cache_ttl 600->1800s, token-cache-fallback=true.
samir_platform: bumped auth retries max_retries=5 base_backoff=200ms max_backoff=3s. watching for amplification.
incident-bot: [METRIC] 18:45:37Z hosted-api/us-west-1 5xx=6.9% (was 12.1%). KMS p95 -> 420ms.
kevin_sre: for Dedicated: enable local gateway auth caching to cut STS calls. Samir, can you patch gateways with ttl=900s?
samir_platform: rolling gateway patch canary to 2 nodes.
deploy-bot: deployment gateway-auth-cache v2.1 -> canary success -> promoted 100% at 18:51:02Z.
lisa_support: drafting status update to customers. publish now?
maria_oncall: publish. include: if you require strict regional data locality expect degraded perf; non-data-local routing will reduce errors. link to status page.
lisa_support: published: "We are investigating increased errors in US-WEST-1 due to upstream AWS egress/control-plane issues. Partial mitigations deployed, routing in progress. Updates every 30m or on material changes." :loudspeaker: 
kevin_sre: rolling routing to 50% -> monitoring. if stable -> 100%.
samir_platform: gateway canary stable, rolling to remaining gateways.
incident-bot: [NOTE] No Sev1 tickets opened yet. support triaging inbound DMs. auto-escalation not triggered.
maria_oncall: handing off oncall to kevin in 5m. full timeline + control-plane creds to kevin.
kevin_sre: taking handoff. next steps: continue rollout to 100%, keep caches, monitor for cross-region latency, prepare AWS engagement if error-rate >1% in 40m.
lisa_support: will update customers every 30m.
incident-bot: [ACTION] follow-ups: contact AWS SLT, inspect NAT gateway metrics, gather KMS control-plane metrics, create postmortem in /incidents/2024-03-25-aws-us-west-1-egress.
kevin_sre: creating incident record "aws-egress-us-west1" and timeline. closing active paging loop. :thumbsup: 
maria_oncall: handoff complete at 18:54:59Z. going offline for backlog.
kevin_sre: acknowledged. monitoring dashboards (auth latency, 5xx, routing errors). will escalate to AWS if needed.
